messages:
maria: Heads-up — after enabling FP8 path on H100/L40S in canary, we see a 9-14% throughput drop for long-context L40S jobs and KV cache churn spikes. Posting profiler snippets and traces. Can someone triage?

raj: :eyes: can you paste the perf dump + which transformer-engine config we rolled?

maria: Rolled `tengine:v3.2-fp8-auto` with kernel-selector=auto, quant-mode=fp8, kv-eviction=dynamic. Perf dump: 

```
# tail of perf profile (samples/sec)
service: decode_tokens
before: 13500 toks/s (int8 mixed)
after: 11600 toks/s (fp8 path)
99pct latency increased from 42ms -> 56ms
KV evictions increased from 0.6% -> 3.2% of requests
```

Also seeing repeated kernel fallback logs: `kernel_select: chosen=fp8_ddp_fast fallback=torus_int8_slow` about 1 per 600 requests.

ken: is the throughput drop proportional to sequence length?

maria: yes — short seq (<512) almost flat; >2048 shows largest regression. Suspect warmup and KV cache interplay with quantized matmul path.

alyssa: that fallback log frequency looks low but could be causing micro-pause on hotpath. Do we have timeline correlation between fallback events and KV eviction spikes?

maria: quick grep shows eviction spikes co-occur within 20-40ms of fallback log. attaching a short trace fragment: 

```
TRACE: request=abc123
  t=0ms queue
  t=12ms kernel(fp8_ddp_fast)
  t=15ms fallback->int8_slow
  t=20ms kv-evict(key=chat_ctx_user_x)
```

raj: hmm. Kernel selector might be over-eager on fp8 for transformer layers with long kv caches. Two angles: 1) selector heuristic (seq_len + kv_size) threshold tweak; 2) transformer-engine config to prefer stable GEMM kernels for large B*N.

ken: also check cuTENSOR/cuBLAS workspace sizes on L40S — FP8 kernels changed workspace allocation which hurts occupancy at long sequences. I can repro locally with a long-context runner.

ci-bot: New perf job queued: run/2798765432-fp8-longseq-sanity — will report flamegraphs when done.

alyssa: For quick mitigation, can we add a runtime simple guard: if seq_len>1024 and kv_cache_size>8MB then force kernel_selector=int8_prefer? That should avoid fallbacks while we dig in.

maria: agree. Also we should bump quant calibration sampling rate for fp8 to avoid miscalib edge-cases. Current auto-calib used 128 samples; try 512 for canary.

raj: good. I'll open a tiny rollout PR to change selector rule + calibration sample param. If ci-bot run looks clean we can push to canary.

ken: I'll attach microbench numbers from local repro by EOD. If we confirm workspace/occupancy issue, we may need a transformer-engine kernel variant tuned for long KV.

maria: thanks. Recording action items: (1) raj PR: selector threshold + calib samples (2) ken: local repro + workspace/occupancy logs (3) ci-bot: perf run + flamegraphs (4) canary rollback plan ready if regression >8% persists.

alyssa: one last ask — add a short telemetry tag so we can filter requests that hit fallback path and see customer impact (route, model, token counts).

maria: done — added `telemetry.fp8_fallback=true` to logs for next 2 hours. Will update when CI run finishes. :thumbsup:
